basis: official and allied sources; metadata links to original publications

records.title: Eastern Europe / Russia–Ukraine
records.why: Nuclear-armed power involvement, civilian suffering, energy infrastructure and escalation pathways.
records.watch: Allied public statements, displacement, infrastructure strikes, negotiations.

records.title: Persian Gulf / Strait of Hormuz
records.why: Oil and LNG supply dependence can transmit rapidly to household costs worldwide.
records.watch: Verified shipping flow, ports, insurance, official maritime notices.
records.context: Chokepoint exposure is not proof of an impending closure.

records.title: Taiwan Strait
records.why: A cross-strait conflict could affect security, semiconductors, maritime access and global trade.
records.watch: Dated official defense statements and verifiable policy changes.
records.context: Military exercises alone do not establish an imminent conflict.

records.title: Korean Peninsula
records.why: Potential for high-consequence military escalation involving regional states.
records.watch: Verified official missile and nuclear announcements, diplomatic channels.
records.context: No numerical war probability is assigned.

records.title: Sudan and surrounding humanitarian systems
records.why: War, displacement and food insecurity compound across neighboring populations.
records.watch: WFP/FAO updates, access to aid, civilian protection.
records.context: Detailed latest conflict boundaries require up-to-date verification.

records.title: Critical mineral refining dependencies
records.why: Geographic separation of mining and processing can amplify export-control shocks.
records.watch: USGS statistics, national policy and trade restrictions.
records.context: Supplier concentration is not a finding of sabotage or intentional harm.

records.title: Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb
records.why: Shipping detours transmit costs and delays to food, energy and other goods.
records.watch: Official maritime warnings and EIA/IEA trade route updates.
records.context: Trade impacts vary by route and date.
